title: The Backward step into the yard
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：backward　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 backward 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the baker wrote of ① a backward step into the yard in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② more backward than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the backward ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most backward step into the yard anybody in the bakery had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too backward to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the backward ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a backward village on the moor, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as backward as the village on the moor they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was backward or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something backward, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite backward; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the backward ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, before dawn, she wrote of another backward step into the yard in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more backward than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most backward village on the moor in the whole bakery, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the backward ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 向后（前置定语 a backward step into the yard：1971 年面点师在账单里记下的那件向后的一步）
B. adj. 向后／落后（比较级 more backward than：文中两处，一处比退进院子的一步，一处比预想）
C. adj. 向后／落后（最高级 the most backward：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 向后（表语 too backward to do：母亲觉得它太向后，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 落后（前置定语 a backward village on the moor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩落后的村子）
F. adj. 落后（同级比较 as backward as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩荒原上的村子相比）
G. adj. 落后（后置定语 something backward：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 落后（受程度副词修饰 quite backward：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a backward step into the yard
the most backward step into the yard anybody
a backward village on the moor
The most backward village on the moor in

answers.why: backward 意为“向后”，1971 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件向后的一步”，此处作前置定语 a backward step into the yard。
backward 意为“向后”，此处用比较级 more backward than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
backward 意为“向后”，账单上 十二月 那行字说它是糕饼铺里最向后的一件，故用最高级 the most backward step into the yard。
backward 意为“向后”，母亲认为这件东西“太向后了，谁也用不上”，too backward to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
backward 意为“落后”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩落后的村子”，此处作前置定语 a backward village on the moor。
backward 意为“落后”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩荒原上的村子一样落后”，同级比较用 as backward as。
backward 意为“落后”，账单上那半行字要的是“落后的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something backward。
backward 意为“落后”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当落后”，quite 修饰原级 backward。
backward 意为“落后”，1981 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要落后”，故用比较级 more backward than。
backward 意为“落后”，母亲 1983 年说的是“整个糕饼铺里最落后的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most backward village on the moor。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件向后的一步。（a backward step into the yard）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更向后。（more backward than …）
母亲觉得它太向后，谁也用不上。（too backward to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩落后的村子。（a backward village on the moor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩荒原上的村子一样落后。（as backward as …）
到了 1978 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件落后的东西。（something backward）
answers: In 1971 the baker wrote of a backward step into the yard in the bill.
Everybody said it was more backward than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too backward to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a backward village on the moor.
He said nobody would call it as backward as the village on the moor they had once had.
By 1978 the bill asked for nothing but something backward.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 backward 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the baker wrote of a backward step into the yard in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most backward step into the yard in the bakery, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too backward to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a backward village on the moor, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite backward, and everybody laughed.
The backward ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
